description: This grouped bar chart illustrates two distinct metrics, "Accuracy (%)" and "Token Count," for four different methods. The horizontal axis categorizes the data into two main spatial groups corresponding to these metrics, though it lacks a specific axis label. The chart features dual vertical value axes: the left axis represents "Accuracy (%)" on a linear scale ranging from 70 to 100 with tick intervals of 5, while the right axis represents "Token Count" on a linear scale ranging from 0 to 800 with tick intervals of 100. Light gray dashed horizontal grid lines extend across the plot area, aligning with the left axis ticks. A legend at the bottom identifies the four methods by color: CoT (red), CoD (orange), CCoT (light blue), and CoUT (green). Each bar is outlined in black and features an exact numerical annotation above it. In the left group representing Accuracy, the bars are ordered CoT, CoD, CCoT, and CoUT, with values of 91.19 (the tallest in this group), 80.89 (the shortest in this group), 88.50, and 88.40, respectively. In the right group representing Token Count, the bars follow the same color and category order but visually appear in descending order of height, starting with the tallest bar for CoT at 676.85, followed by CoD at 534.24, CCoT at 445.91, and the shortest bar for CoUT at 354.46.
